campaign.objective.wood.description: Store at least 12 units of wood in any of the eight storage crates. This checks the current shared stock: wood in a backpack does not count, and consuming stored wood reduces progress.
campaign.objective.iron.description: After completing the mining objective, produce 1 unit of iron in the furnace. Supply iron ore and power the workshop. Completion counts when production finishes, even before you collect the output. Existing ingots do not count.
campaign.objective.battery.description: After starting the generator, store 0.05 kWh in the battery. Enable the battery and leave spare generator capacity for charging. Reaching this charge once is enough.
campaign.objective.perimeter.description: Every outer and inner perimeter section, including gates, needs at least 75% condition. An intact base already meets this requirement. Repair damage with a hammer and concrete; new damage can make this objective incomplete again.
core.chapter.check.goal: Main goal: establish power, mine ore and report to Command Core.
core.chapter.free.goal: Prepare your supplies and explore at your own pace.
campaign.objective.copper.description: After smelting your first iron, produce 2 copper ingots in the furnace. Existing stock does not count. This is an optional preparation goal.
campaign.objective.medical.description: Keep at least 3 medical supplies in the Level 1 storage crates. Supplies in your backpack do not count. The goal updates when the stock changes.
campaign.objective.drone.description: After starting the generator, deploy a working drone with at least 20% battery. Completion is kept if you later pack it.
campaign.objective.light.description: Supply the workshop lighting circuit with power. The goal remains complete while the lights receive power.

chapter1.title: Last Base
chapter1.description: LAST BASE still stands, but the power is down, the gates are damaged and the perimeter is breached. This place can still shelter you. Bring back the lights, repair the critical damage and see the dawn.
chapter1.goal: Restore the base and survive a night from 20:00 to 06:00.
chapter1.restored.title: Base restored
chapter1.restored.description: The lights are back, the critical repairs are complete and you have survived the night. LAST BASE is your shelter again.
chapter1.restored.goal: Continue gathering, crafting and repairing the remaining damage. The next chapter is not available yet.
chapter1.c1_tools.title: Prepare your tools
chapter1.c1_tools.description: Your axe is in a quick slot; the pickaxe and hammer are in your backpack. Use the hammer for repairs. Select tools through the inventory. These instructions remain available while Command Core is unpowered.
chapter1.c1_fuel.title: Collect the emergency supplies
chapter1.c1_fuel.description: On Level 1, go to Storage. Open the unpowered door manually. The first crate along the north wall holds 12 fuel and 40 stone: transfer them to your backpack. You already have a hammer, axe and pickaxe for recovery.
chapter1.c1_tank.title: Refuel the tank
chapter1.c1_tank.description: Open the Energy Room door manually and approach the fuel tank. Add fuel from your backpack. If your backpack is full, free a slot using Storage; a failed transfer does not discard supplies.
chapter1.c1_power.title: Restore base power
chapter1.c1_power.description: Start the generator in the Energy Room. The corridor, Core, Workshop and Storage circuits are ready; enable other circuits as needed. Spare power charges the battery. Save fuel by switching off unused loads.
chapter1.c1_core.title: Reconnect to Command Core
chapter1.c1_core.description: Approach Command Core in the central Level 1 corridor and open it while powered. Chapters shows the recovery plan; Base shows system status. Viewing objectives remotely does not count as accessing the terminal.
chapter1.c1_materials.title: Produce 18 concrete
chapter1.c1_materials.description: At the Workshop furnace, select Concrete. Producing 18 concrete takes 36 stone; the emergency crate contains 40. Collect the output. Jobs and finished items are retained through power loss or a full backpack. Mine more stone on the surface with your pickaxe.
chapter1.c1_repairs.title: Repair three critical structures
chapter1.c1_repairs.description: Equip the hammer and fully repair the breached left section of the north outer wall, the south outer gate and the Level 1 Storage door. The initial damage costs 18 concrete. Partial repairs and paid repair credit persist; further damage needs more materials. Other sections can be repaired later. Required costs: breach 10, outer gate 6, Storage door 2 concrete. If concrete runs short: mine extra stone with the pickaxe → make concrete in the furnace (2 stone per concrete) → finish the repairs.
chapter1.c1_night.title: Survive the night
chapter1.c1_night.description: Stay alive from 20:00 until 06:00 the next day on the world clock. You may shelter in the bunker. Pausing or closing the game does not advance the night. After a death, try again the following night. Then complete the chapter at a powered Core. A night survived during earlier tasks already counts.
chapter1.c1_mine.title: Try the pickaxe
chapter1.c1_mine.description: Select the pickaxe and mine at least 15 resources on the surface. Pickaxe upgrades increase yield and speed; axe upgrades increase speed while keeping 10 wood per hit. Use the enhancement station to upgrade tools.
chapter1.c1_battery.title: Charge the reserve battery
chapter1.c1_battery.description: Store 0.05 kWh in the battery. It can support available loads when the generator stops. More fuel is available at surface gas stations; the nearest is northwest of the base. Fuel containers can be searched without power.

onboarding.description: The base is damaged and the power is out. Start with emergency supplies, make tools and bring LAST BASE back to life.
onboarding.goal: Make your first tools, restore power and rebuild five destroyed sections. After the first night, confirm completion at Command Core.
onboarding.c1_storage.title: Find the emergency container
onboarding.c1_storage.description: Enter the lower-right room off the central hall. Open the first container along its upper wall: it contains guaranteed starter supplies.
onboarding.c1_supplies.title: Collect starter materials
onboarding.c1_supplies.description: Take 12 wood, 10 iron and 10 stone from the emergency container. It also holds fuel. This covers a bench, three tools and the repair lesson.
onboarding.c1_build.title: Craft a Utility Workbench
onboarding.c1_build.description: Approach the permanent Command Core in the central hall → Construction. Utility Workbench: 6 wood + 4 iron. Manual assembly works without power; the bench goes into Inventory.
onboarding.c1_place.title: Place the Utility Workbench
onboarding.c1_place.description: Open Inventory → Base equipment → Utility Workbench → Place. Choose a suitable room, leave the working side accessible and confirm.
onboarding.c1_hammer.title: Make a Hammer
onboarding.c1_hammer.description: Make a Hammer at the Utility Workbench: 2 wood + 2 iron. No electricity is needed. Collect it and assign it to a quick slot for repairs.
onboarding.c1_pickaxe.title: Make a Pickaxe
onboarding.c1_pickaxe.description: Make a Pickaxe at the Utility Workbench: 2 wood + 2 iron. It lets you mine stone and ore on the surface. Resources are gained on impact.
onboarding.c1_tank.title: Fuel the tank
onboarding.c1_tank.description: Take fuel from the emergency container and add it to the tank in the upper-right room. Wall repairs are not needed to start the generator.
onboarding.c1_power.title: Restore base power
onboarding.c1_power.description: Start the generator beside the tank. The Smelter and Command Core need electricity. Disable unnecessary consumers if overloaded; the Utility Workbench remains manual.
onboarding.c1_core.title: Open the powered Command Core
onboarding.c1_core.description: Approach and open Command Core after restoring power. Base shows system status and lets you rename rooms.
onboarding.c1_materials.title: Produce 5 Concrete
onboarding.c1_materials.description: Power the Smelter and produce 5 Concrete from the 10 starter stone. Collect it into your bag. For full repairs later: mine stone → produce Concrete → continue repairing.
onboarding.c1_repairs.title: Rebuild the critical walls
onboarding.c1_repairs.description: Repair the three destroyed straight sections of the north outer wall and the lower two sections of the east wall. The first real repair of each counts when it becomes a physical barrier again. Full HP is not required. After credit is shown, stop and move to the next section.
onboarding.c1_night.title: Survive the first night
onboarding.c1_night.description: Stay alive from 20:00 to 06:00. The bunker is a safe shelter. Save/load preserves a started night; closing the game does not skip it. Then confirm chapter completion at Command Core.
onboarding.c1_axe.title: Make an Axe for wood
onboarding.c1_axe.description: Optional: make an Axe at the Utility Workbench for 2 wood + 2 iron. Starter supplies include these materials. Trees yield 10 resources per successful hit; levels 0–5 increase gathering speed.
build.bootstrapReserve: These materials are reserved for your first workbench, hammer, pickaxe and axe. Craft those first or gather extra materials.

story.arrival.title: The last refuge
story.arrival.summary: The events leading to your arrival.
story.arrival.1: At first, it was only a report of a fallen meteorite.
story.arrival.2: Then came unfamiliar creatures. Infection followed.
story.arrival.3: The cities fell silent. Help never arrived.
story.arrival.4: LAST BASE is still standing. Restore it. Start with the emergency container.
story.core.title: Restart report
story.core.summary: What remains accessible after restarting the Command Core.
story.core.1: The Command Core is responding again. Local base controls are available, but only part of the archive survived.
story.core.2: Recovered documents will appear here. Reading records does not spend Research Data and is not required to operate equipment.
story.research01.title: Research log 01
story.research01.summary: The first recovered fragment of a laboratory journal.
story.research01.1:
Researcher’s note

The first samples came from the impact area. During the initial examination, they appeared to be ordinary rock.
story.research01.2: Today, the structure of one sample changed. Repeated measurements confirmed the difference. I requested isolation and separate monitoring.
story.research01.3: It is too early to explain the cause. The next record is damaged.
story.recovered.title: Base recovery report
story.recovered.summary: A record of the first stage of LAST BASE’s recovery.
story.recovered.1: Critical damage has been repaired. Essential systems are operating again. The base survived its first night after recovery.
story.recovered.2: Keep fuel and materials in reserve. There are still gaps in the archive: restoring the base has not explained what happened to the world.

exploration.source.service_cache: 12 Research Data and the Scout Drone service blueprint.
exploration.site.station_records.desc: Search the southern station warehouse. Follow the central road to return home.
exploration.source.station_records: 16 Research Data and the precision weapons blueprint.
story.field.title: Field journal: the way back
story.field.summary: A short field team note about local routes.
story.field.1: “Mark your return route before heading to the next building. The bridge saves time, but the eastern road remains passable.”
story.field.2: The reverse side retains a service centre code and a southern station warehouse marker. The remaining pages are waterlogged. The notes do not explain what happened to the team.
